title: Conversational Generalized Linear Bandits with Hybrid Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.35262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational bandits improve recommendations by actively querying users about key-terms to elicit their item preferences. However, existing methods typically assume homogeneous feedback for items and key-terms, using either absolute rewards or pairwise comparisons. In practice, item feedback often takes the form of clicks or ratings, while comparisons are more natural for key-terms. To address this gap, we study conversational generalized linear bandits with hybrid feedback, combining absolute item rewards and relative key-term comparisons. We propose Conversational UCB with Hybrid Feedback (HyConUCB), which constructs unified confidence bounds from heterogeneous feedback and adaptively selects key-term comparisons by balancing information gain and directional coverage. Through a refined regret analysis that jointly exploits both feedback sources, we establish a regret bound that improves upon reward-only and adapted dueling-only bench

translated_title: 具有混合反馈的会话式广义线性老虎机
translated_abstract: 会话式老虎机通过主动询问用户关键词以引出其对物品的偏好，从而改进推荐效果。然而，现有方法通常假设物品和关键词采用同质的反馈形式，即要么使用绝对奖励，要么使用成对比较。但在实践中，物品反馈通常以点击或评分的形式出现，而对关键词进行比较则更为自然。为填补这一空白，我们研究了具有混合反馈的会话式广义线性老虎机，将物品的绝对奖励与关键词的相对比较相结合。我们提出了具有混合反馈的会话式UCB算法（HyConUCB），该算法从异构反馈中构建统一的置信界，并通过平衡信息增益与方向覆盖度来自适应地选择关键词比较。通过联合利用两种反馈来源的精细化遗憾分析，我们建立了优于仅使用奖励反馈和经改造的仅使用对决比较反馈基准的遗憾界。
tldr: 该论文提出HyConUCB算法，通过结合物品绝对奖励与关键词相对比较的混合反馈机制改进会话式老虎机推荐，并利用联合遗憾分析建立了优于现有单一反馈基准的遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HyConUCB, a conversational generalized linear bandit algorithm that combines absolute item rewards with relative key-term comparisons as hybrid feedback, establishing an improved regret bound over reward-only and dueling-only benchmarks through joint regret analysis of both feedback sources.
